title: Mitigating Query Shortcuts in Chain-of-Thought with Context-Aware Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.29518v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), recent studies have shown that final answers do not always depend on the generated rationales. In particular, LLMs may rely on query-specific shortcuts rather than the information provided by their reasoning steps. In this paper, we investigate whether context-aware decoding (CAD), an existing contrastive decoding method, can mitigate such shortcut behavior when applied to CoT reasoning. We study this application as Rationale Contrastive Decoding (RCD), which contrasts the next-token distributions conditioned on the query with and without its rationale, amplifying tokens whose likelihood increases due to the rationale. We provide a theoretical interpretation of this decoding rule via a KL-regularized reward-maximization objective. Experiments across five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RCD improves answer accuracy over standar

translated_title: 利用上下文感知解码缓解思维链中的查询捷径问题
translated_abstract: 虽然思维链提示提升了大型语言模型（LLM）的推理性能，但近期研究表明，最终答案并不总是依赖于所生成的推理依据。特别是，LLM可能依赖于针对查询本身的捷径，而非其推理步骤所提供的信息。在本文中，我们研究了上下文感知解码——一种已有的对比解码方法——在应用于思维链推理时能否缓解这种捷径行为。我们将这一应用称为推理依据对比解码（RCD），该方法对比查询在有无推理依据条件下预测的下一个词元分布，从而放大那些因推理依据而似然度增加的词元。我们通过KL正则化的奖励最大化目标对这一解码规则给出了理论解释。在五个推理基准上的实验表明，RCD相比标准解码方法提升了答案准确率。
tldr: 提出推理依据对比解码（RCD）方法，通过对比查询在有无推理依据时的词元分布来放大推理依据的作用，从而缓解LLM在思维链推理中依赖查询捷径的行为并提升答案准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Rationale Contrastive Decoding (RCD), which mitigates query shortcut behavior in Chain-of-Thought reasoning by contrasting next-token distributions with and without rationales, thereby improving answer accuracy across five reasoning benchmarks.
